summary: Anthropic released ten pre-built agent templates for financial-services tasks (pitchbooks, KYC, month-end close), new Microsoft 365 add-ins, and additional data connectors and an MCP app for Claude.

mechanisms.reason: The release packages autonomous, tool-using agents that run whole finance workflows (deal closes, KYC, ledger reconciliation) rather than being operated seat-by-seat by analysts.
mechanisms.quote: We\u2019re releasing ten ready-to-run agent templates for the most time-consuming work in financial services: building pitchbooks, screening KYC files, and closing the books at month-end.

mechanisms.reason: Managed agents running long, autonomous sessions on nightly schedules or across a whole book of deals implies materially more inference calls per task than single-turn chat use.
mechanisms.quote: long-running sessions that can work throughout a multi-hour deal close, per-tool permissions, managed credential vaults, and a full audit log
